attribution.preferred_citation: Dzmitryi Kharlanau. "SAP Sales Process Atlas". CC BY-NC 4.0. https://dkharlanau.github.io/labs/enterprise-context/sales-processes/

provenance.evidence_policy: Public SAP sources are used for reference and verification only; explanatory text and memory models are independently authored.

meta.summary: Stable mnemonic codes for SAP sales process variants and overlays, separated from changeable SAP scope-item identifiers.

code_system.rule: The code is ours and stays stable even if SAP renames a scope item or app. SAP scope-item IDs remain external references, not primary keys.

process_codes.title: Sell from Stock
process_codes.memory_hook: Own stock, own delivery, normal O2C.

process_codes.title: Sales Quotation
process_codes.memory_hook: Promise before commitment.

process_codes.title: Free-of-Charge Delivery
process_codes.memory_hook: Move goods without charging the customer.

process_codes.title: Sales Contract Management
process_codes.memory_hook: Commit a quantity or value now; call it off later.

process_codes.title: Third-Party Order Processing
process_codes.memory_hook: We sell it; the vendor ships it.

process_codes.title: Purchase-to-Order / Order-Specific Procurement
process_codes.memory_hook: Buy for one customer, receive it, then deliver it.

sap_scope_items.label: Sales of Non-Stock Item with Order-Specific Procurement

process_codes.title: Customer Consignment
process_codes.memory_hook: Our stock sits at the customer until they consume it.

process_codes.title: Classic Intercompany Sales
process_codes.memory_hook: One company sells; another company delivers and bills internally.

process_codes.title: Advanced Intercompany Sales
process_codes.memory_hook: Cross-company sales becomes an orchestrated value chain.

sap_scope_items.label: Advanced Intercompany Sales – MTO and Variant Configuration

process_codes.title: Sell from Stock with Valuated Stock in Transit
process_codes.memory_hook: Goods left the plant, but we still own/control them.

sap_scope_items.label: Sell from Stock with Valuated Stock in Transit

process_codes.title: Sell from Stock with Advanced Down Payment
process_codes.memory_hook: Collect cash before final delivery billing, but keep the sales flow intact.

sap_scope_items.label: Sell from Stock with Down Payment Processing

process_codes.title: Milestone Billing with Advanced Down Payment
process_codes.memory_hook: Bill the project in stages; collect down payments against the same staged logic.

sap_scope_items.label: Sales Order Processing with Milestone Billing

process_codes.title: Bills of Material in Sales Documents
process_codes.memory_hook: One commercial item can explode into many fulfillment items.

process_codes.title: Make-to-Order
process_codes.memory_hook: The sales order creates its own supply segment.

sap_scope_items.label: Make-to-Order Production – Finished Goods Sales and Final Assembly

process_codes.title: Cash Sales
process_codes.memory_hook: Order, hand over, and take payment almost at once.

process_codes.title: Rush Order
process_codes.memory_hook: Deliver now; invoice later.

process_codes.title: Customer Returns
process_codes.memory_hook: The outbound flow runs backward, but disposition decides what happens next.

process_codes.title: Sales Scheduling Agreements
process_codes.memory_hook: The customer sends a rolling delivery signal instead of individual orders.

process_codes.title: Omnichannel Sales Promotions
process_codes.memory_hook: Pricing asks an external promotion brain.

process_codes.title: Related Objects & Process Flow
process_codes.memory_hook: A sales document is a node in a chain, not an isolated record.

extension_codes.title: Custom logic and BAdIs
extension_codes.memory_hook: Use a defined hook, not an invisible side effect.

extension_codes.title: APIs and integration contracts
extension_codes.memory_hook: The integration boundary is part of the process design.

extension_codes.title: Reference and copy-control logic
extension_codes.memory_hook: A follow-on document inherits rules, not just fields.

extension_codes.title: Side-by-side capabilities
extension_codes.memory_hook: Keep orchestration outside the core when ownership sits outside the ERP transaction.
